theorems.name: Submission.cbrsl_slice_boundary_mass_bound
theorems.statement: (∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (k + 1)) (μ μ' : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P (k + 1)) (ξ' : Euclid P → MultiVector P k) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (L : NNReal), IsOpen U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ' K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ' μ' → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) (k + 1), |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ', ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) k, |ξ' x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (k + 1), T ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (k + 1)) x) ∂μ) → (∀ η : TestFormOn U k, T.boundary η = ∫ x, ξ' x ((η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ') → LipschitzWith L f → ∃ (A : ℝ → GeometricCurrentOn U (k + 1)) (B : ℝ → GeometricCurrentOn U k), (∀ (t : ℝ) (ω : TestFormOn U (k + 1)), A t ω = ∫ x in {x | f x < t}, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (k + 1)) x) ∂μ) ∧ (∀ (t : ℝ) (η : TestFormOn U k), B t η = ∫ x in {x | f x < t}, ξ' x ((η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ') ∧ (∀ (t : ℝ) (η : TestFormOn U k), Disjoint (tsupport (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k)) {x | f x = t} → (A t).boundary η = B t η) ∧ (∀ (W : Set (Euclid P)) (t : ℝ), IsOpen W → ((A t).boundary - B t).massOn W ≤ (L : ℝ≥0∞) * liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ * μ (W ∩ {x | t - h < f x ∧ f x < t})) (𝓝[>] 0)) ∧ (∀ (W : Set (Euclid P)) (a b : ℝ), IsOpen W → ∫⁻ t in Ioo a b, ((A t).boundary - B t).massOn W ≤ (L : ℝ≥0∞) * μ (W ∩ {x | a < f x ∧ f x < b}))) → ∀ (P d : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U (d + 1)) (μ μ' : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P (d + 1)) (ξ' : Euclid P → MultiVector P d) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (L : NNReal), IsOpen U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ' K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ' μ' → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) (d + 1), |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ', ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) d, |ξ' x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (d + 1), X ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (d + 1)) x) ∂μ) → (∀ η : TestFormOn U d, X.boundary η = ∫ x, ξ' x ((η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) x) ∂μ') → LipschitzWith L f → ∃ (A : ℝ → GeometricCurrentOn U (d + 1)) (B : ℝ → GeometricCurrentOn U d), (∀ (t : ℝ) (ω : TestFormOn U (d + 1)), A t ω = ∫ x in {x | f x < t}, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (d + 1)) x) ∂μ) ∧ (∀ (t : ℝ) (η : TestFormOn U d), B t η = ∫ x in {x | f x < t}, ξ' x ((η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) x) ∂μ') ∧ (∀ (W : Set (Euclid P)) (t : ℝ), IsOpen W → ((A t).boundary - B t).massOn W + boundaryMassOn ((A t).boundary - B t) W ≤ (L : ℝ≥0∞) * liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ * (μ + μ') (W ∩ {x | t - h < f x ∧ f x < t})) (𝓝[>] 0))
